correctness.rationale: The Hom table and radical dimension follow by direct chain-map equations for one-degree and identity-disk indecomposables; the quotient is a product of matrix algebras and the radical is nilpotent. Boolean projectors classify every simultaneous direct-sum decomposition. Stabilizers give exact counts, and restrictions to the colored summands give all three rank systems. The reduced orbits are clopen by locally constant ranks of induced projectors on homology and boundaries. Eleven direct full-histogram computations and twelve symbolic closed-form checks agree with the proof; finite checks are not substituted for the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: Simultaneous strict cochain retracts form a natural complete classification problem. The full joint degreewise, boundary and homology ranks distinguish chain-level simultaneous decompositions invisible to homology alone. Exact group-order coefficients and geometric component dimensions work for all bounded complexes and finite fields, including repeated indecomposables where nontrivial GL factors and partial flag varieties appear. The example with two disks and two homology spheres has 5860 commuting pairs over F2, of which 409 induce zero on homology, illustrating the invariant’s intrinsic motivation and nontriviality.
